changes.reason: Use the current Eurostat percentage-of-EU27 index based on PPS at current prices, so EU27_2020 is the explicit index-100 benchmark.
Eurostat identifies NLPR_PER as annual nominal labour productivity per person in nama_10_lp_ulc; NLPR_EMP was not the registered Eurostat item intended by the design.
Make the annual frequency explicit in every primary API request rather than relying on dataset defaults.

data_exposure_statement.interpretation: This is a source-implementation correction inside an already motivated follow-up study, not a pristine preregistration amendment.
